name: MiraGe
definition: A method that encodes 2D images by simulating human interpretation, treating a 2D image as a flat object within a 3D space to allow intuitive and flexible image editing and complex transformations.
summary: MiraGe edits 2D images by converting selections into 3D Gaussian meshes for intuitive manipulation, distinguishing itself by using explicit 3D reconstruction rather than generative synthesis.
